title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Apply SOLID principles to craft maintainable and high-quality code

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes align with business requirements and degreed strategy

- Engage closely with designers, UX, and other developers to grasp new features, dependencies, and technical intricacies

- Fulfill other assigned duties


Requirements:


- Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)

- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL Databases

- Experience with Microservices and the Cloud

- Knowledge of algorithms

- Understanding of IT infrastructure

- Proficiency in managing Agile methodologies

- Familiarity with best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions

- Understanding of Design Patterns

- Experience in developing entire applications from scratch

- Proficiency in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines

- Experience with version control

- Strong skills in unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Pharmaceutical Retailers and Distributors (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specializing in business, healthcare, and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association, and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).

About - We are looking for professionals in large pharmacy retailers and distributors for a paid consultancy section.

Qualifications:

  • Responsible for purchasing, procurement, or supply chain decisions within Consumer Healthcare retail and wholesale organizations
  • The purpose of this study is to understand the evolving landscape of trust, regulation, and reputation within the healthcare industry.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an online survey , lasting around 20 minutes.

Compensation package - BRL R$750 for 20 minutes online survey

title: Facial Action Coding Specialist – FACS Certified(remote)
description:
Company Description

Huzzle is a platform dedicated to connecting world-class experts with AI labs and enterprises. Leveraging an innovative AI recruiter, Huzzle provides seamless sourcing, in-depth vetting, and targeted training for large volumes of talent. Known for maintaining consistently high-quality services, Huzzle partners with organisations to match the best experts to their needs. Join our mission to empower businesses in unlocking their potential through top-tier talent and AI-driven solutions.


Location: Remote

Contract Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Start: ASAP

Pay: $20–$30/hr


Role Description

This is a remote, short-term freelance contract role for a Facial Action Coding Specialist – FACS Certified. The specialist will analyse facial expressions using the Facial Action Coding System (FACS) to identify and document emotional and facial actions accurately. Responsibilities may include examining video content, coding facial movements, and providing detailed reports with insights.


Qualifications

  • FACS certification and advanced expertise in applying the system to analyse facial expressions
  • Strong detail-oriented analytical and observation skills
  • Proficiency in documenting and presenting analytical findings in both written and visual formats
  • Experience with AI-related projects or understanding of emotion and behaviour analysis is a plus
  • Excellent communication and time-management skills with the ability to meet contractual goals in a remote setting
  • High level of written English proficiency

title: Consultor ABAP/FIORI/CPI (PJ)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuação em desenvolvimentos ABAP avançados em ambiente SAP S/4HANA (Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, CDS Views).
  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações SAP Fiori (Freestyle e/ou Fiori Elements) , com foco em usabilidade e performance.
  • Construção, manutenção e suporte de integrações via SAP CPI , incluindo:
  • Integrações SAP ↔ SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, Ariba, SuccessFactors).
  • Integrações SAP ↔ sistemas legados e terceiros (REST, SOAP, IDoc, OData).

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Perfil Profissional:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor versátil e inovador com experiência em Kotlin, AWS e Go, especializado em criar soluções de software eficientes e escaláveis. Este profissional deve combinar habilidades de desenvolvimento back-end e serviços em nuvem para construir aplicativos de alto desempenho, que atendem às necessidades de negócios dinâmicos.


Habilidades e Competências:

  • Desenvolvimento em Kotlin e Go: Proficiência em ambas as linguagens, com experiência prática na construção de aplicativos e serviços back-end, utilizando Kotlin para desenvolvimento de aplicações e Go para serviços de alta performance.
  • AWS: Ampla experiência em utilizar serviços AWS, como ECS, Lambda, API Gateway e S3, para desenvolver e otimizar aplicações em nuvem.
  • Microserviços: Experiência em projetar arquiteturas de microserviços que possibilitem escalabilidade e manutenção eficiente, integrando soluções em Kotlin e Go.
  • Banco de Dados: Familiaridade com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, incluindo otimização de consultas e implementação de estratégias de persistência de dados.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Habilidade em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis, utilizando práticas de CI/CD para garantir alta qualidade e entrega contínua de software.

title: B2C Analyst - Transportation Specialist - Remote
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Job Description


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Daily Responsibilities:

  • Track and trace e-Commerce shipments in North America (sales, returns, trade-ins, replacements) to identify possible delays and create action to troubleshoot (only when needed).
  • Analyze weekly and monthly on-time delivery metrics (OTD) for North America. Proactively collaborate with the Transportation carriers for root cause analysis and action plans.
  • Update, automate (with help of other Google teams) and monitor centralized KPI boards.
  • Resolve escalations from customers and/or internal stakeholders regarding shipment status all the way until resolution by collaborating with Transportation carriers and other Google teams/functions (customer support, Fulfillment, 3PL).
  • Support Google Transportation Operations Manager in transportation master data configurations and troubleshooting.
  • Support Transportation requirements for ongoing cross functional Projects.


Mandatory Skills/Qualifications:

  • Transportation experience, or warehouse experience. (preferably in parcel transportation)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving experience, combined with strong business judgment and an ability to present analysis in a clear and compelling manner;
  • Able to navigate ambiguity in work to find issues and work with the appropriate teams to fix/find a solution. ability to follow up with cross functional teams.
  • Must be detail oriented, and able to work under tight deadlines and with a sense of urgency.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.


Required to work in the US PST time zone.


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.

Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure

Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business

Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.

Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Cold-Formed Steel Framing BIM Specialist (MWF)
description:
ENG has evolved, expanded and become increasingly complex, but continues to be dedicated to being a high-growth, well-run, profitable business with employees and contractors located throughout the world.

A modeler, as its very name says, is the one who models the buildings in Revit or similar programs. Depending on their seniority or expertise, they can model one or more disciplines. Modelers at ENG must also understand and review discipline specifications, project manuals, and submittals (Quality Analysis), and be able to read the design information provided by our clients to create accurate and constructible BIM models.

  • Civil Engineering degree (Framing background).
  • +3 years of experience in BIM MEP.
  • Broad knowledge of Revit & Navisworks.

Desirable Requirements :

  • MWF software knowledge.
  • Experience in US-based projects.

Company Culture and Values

  • Candor: We value honesty, openness, and sincerity in all interactions.
  • Accountability: We take ownership and are committed to delivering high-quality work on time.
  • Win-Win Mentality: We strive for mutual success in all business relationships.

Growth Opportunities

As part of our commitment to your career progression, we offer:

  • Career Development Programs.
  • Internal Mobility.
  • Performance-Based Promotions.
  • Leadership Opportunities.
  • Project Diversity.

Why join us? Explore our amazing benefits! ✨

Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.

Unlimited PTO: Recharge with flexible paid time off when you need it.

Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, fun challenges and team celebrations.

Continuous Learning: Programs to develop your technical and soft skills.

Work Equipment to Keep You Productive: We provide everything you need to create the perfect workspace.

Tech & Office Allowances: Upgrade your workspace with our one-time allowances. With \"Pimp up your Devices,\" and “Home Office set up allowance” you can upgrade gadgets for a better experience.

Monthly Internet Allowance: Stay connected with a monthly allowance for internet and expenses.

Highly Competitive Compensation Package: Includes both fixed and variable payments, all processed in our local currency, USD.

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English

Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Finance Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Finance & Operations Manager (Part-Time)

About the Company:

Our client is a fast-growing B2B software company providing enterprises, especially financial institutions, with a platform to accelerate innovation. The platform simplifies the discovery, validation, and scaling of vendors, tools, and data solutions, reducing the time, risk, and cost associated with adopting fintech solutions.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Finance & Operations Manager to work closely with the CFO and take ownership of day-to-day finance and selected operational responsibilities. This is a hands-on, number-two role within the finance function, ideal for someone who enjoys both detailed execution and contributing to strategic initiatives in a scaling environment. This position is part-time and fully remote.

Responsibilities:

• Lead and own the month-end close and bookkeeping processes.

• Consolidate multiple entities into a single, accurate set of accounts (essential requirement).

• Manage day-to-day accounts payable and receivable processes.

• Support the CFO with financial planning, KPI tracking, and preparation of investor materials.

• Maintain and update financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Support international expansion initiatives from a finance and compliance perspective.

• Assist with operational responsibilities, including contributing to SOC 2 and ISO certification processes.

• Identify process improvements across Finance and Operations and implement practical solutions.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).

• Proven experience consolidating multiple entities into one set of accounts.

• Strong experience leading month-end close processes and managing bookkeeping.

• Experience in fast-paced or high-growth environments.

• Strong attention to detail with a high level of reliability and diligence.

• Ability to work autonomously and balance multiple priorities effectively.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience maintaining and updating financial forecasts and cash flow models.

• Experience with cap table management software and compliance processes.

• Exposure to supporting audit, certification, or regulatory processes (e.g., SOC 2, ISO).

Personality:

• Hands-on and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership.

• Comfortable operating both at a detailed level and in strategic discussions.

• Flexible working style with strong organizational skills.

• Collaborative and adaptable in a scaling business environment.

Software & Tools:

• Accounting and bookkeeping software.

• Financial forecasting and cash flow modeling tools.

• Cap table management software.

• Compliance and certification tracking tools (SOC 2, ISO).

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

Part-Time UK Business Hours

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the finance function within a high-growth company.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:

Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend - Pleno para se unir ao nosso Time de Development para:

  • Desenvolvimento de novas features e correções de bugs, seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Participação do ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento de projetos de Software;
  • Auxílio ativo no refinamento de necessidades técnicas;
  • Participação dos ritos em um modelo de desenvolvimento ágil;
  • Execução de testes de desenvolvimento e auxílio ao time de QA para validação das entregas;
  • Apoio aos times de Operações, Projetos e Produtos nas necessidades técnicas;
  • Apoio ao cliente em dúvidas relacionadas com a integração com os nossos produtos.;

Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, SpringBoot, APIs Rest, Arquitetura de microsserviços, CI/CD;
  • Experiência com planejamento, e estimava de desenvolvimento de Software;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Orchestrador;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura baseada a eventos, e serviços de mensageria;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento de código e práticas CI/CD (Git);
  • Conhecimento sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software/engenharia de software, da concepção à entrega;
  • Conhecimento dos principais Design Patterns;
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento: SOLID, K.I.S.S, Clean Code;
  • Conhecimento de base de dados (SQL, noSql);
  • Conhecimento de testes unitários;
  • Proficiência na qualidade das entregas e do funcionamento das soluções desenvolvidas como um todo.

Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em análise e aperfeiçoamento de performance de APIs;
  • Inglês intermediário;

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

O profissional irá atuar com Android, passando por todo ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde o levantamento de requisitos até a implantação dos projetos, apoiando na construção de produtos.

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em Aplicações Mobile com Kotlin

Experiência com Android

Atuação com Github, Testes de Software

CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:

More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India . Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.

We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Title: Application Support Engineer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Role Description: The Application Support Engineer is responsible for administering and supporting the ticketing system, as well as providing operational support, maintenance, and lifecycle management for both SaaS (vendor-managed) and self-managed enterprise applications. This role ensures applications are secure, available, performant, and compliant, while serving as a key coordination point between vendors, internal infrastructure teams, InfoSec, and business stakeholders.

Mandatory Experience: SaaS-Ticketing system, Atlassian suite, Jira. also have experience managing on-premise applications running on windows or Linux platforms that require patch and update deployment. The most important qualities are independence and a strong willingness to learn.

Job Experience Requirements:

  • 3–7 years of experience supporting the ticketing system and enterprise applications across SaaS and self-managed models.
  • Hands-on experience with application deployments, patching, and maintenance for self-managed systems.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS operating models, vendor support, and SLA management.
  • Experience with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem, request management).
  • Hands-on experience in administering and supporting ticketing systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot across applications, infrastructure, and integration layers.
  • Strong communication skills to work with vendors and cross-functional IT teams.
  • Experience supporting business-critical or regulated applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid environments.
  • Knowledge of IAM, observability, and security controls.

Job Responsibilities:

Self-Managed Application Support

  • Perform application maintenance for self-managed applications, including deployment of application updates, patches, and fixes.
  • Support production and non-production environments (dev, test, staging, prod).
  • Execute deployments following approved change management (CAB) processes.
  • Monitor application health, availability, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve L2/L3 issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Cloud Infrastructure, IAM, and InfoSec teams for changes and remediation.

SaaS (Managed Service) Application Support

  • Act as the primary IT point of contact for SaaS applications managed by external vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support escalations, and SLA adherence.
  • Coordinate SaaS releases, upgrades, and vendor-led changes, including impact assessment and business communications.
  • Validate vendor patching, security updates, and release notes for enterprise impact.
  • Support SaaS configuration changes, user provisioning, role management, and integrations.
  • Partner with InfoSec and Compliance to support risk assessments, audits, and vendor reviews.

Incident, Request & Service Management

  • Provide L2/L3 support for incidents and service requests across SaaS and self-managed applications.
  • Collaborate with GSD / Client Services for L1 support and escalation workflows.
  • Ensure timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and proper ticket documentation.

Security, Compliance & Risk

  • Support application patching and vulnerability remediation (self-managed) and validation (SaaS).
  • Ensure applications align with IAM, data protection, and enterprise security standards.
  • Support audit, SOX, GxP, and compliance activities by providing operational evidence.

Governance, Documentation & Lifecycle Management

  • Maintain application documentation, runbooks, and support models.
  • Participate in application onboarding, upgrades, renewals, and decommissioning.
  • Support application rationalization and standardization initiatives.

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Where you Fit In:

As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.

The impact you will have:

Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.

Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.

Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.

Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.

Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).

What we’re looking for:

We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.

This role is Remote based in Brazil.

Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

description:
We Are Sportingtech :

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Where you Fit In:

As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.

The impact you will have:

Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.

Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.

Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.

Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.

Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).

What we’re looking for:

We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.

This role is Remote based in Brazil.

Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

title: Head of Community
description:
Warmy.io — Remote | Global | B2B SaaS | AI

Warmy is not building “a community.”

We are building the home of email deliverability on the internet.

If someone works in email — agencies, SDR leaders, founders, growth teams, ESPs — we want one natural place they belong.

That place is Warmy.

We’re looking for a builder. A connector. A natural networker.

Someone who can turn customers into advocates, strangers into members, and conversations into movements.

If you’ve ever thought: “I could build the HubSpot of deliverability communities” — this role is for you.

About Warmy

Warmy is a revolutionary AI-powered email deliverability platform helping companies land in the inbox, not spam. We serve customers worldwide and are scaling fast with a fully remote international team.

We move quickly. We care about impact. We measure results.

Your Mission

Build the largest and most trusted global community in email deliverability.

Not a Slack group.

Not a newsletter.

A real ecosystem where professionals learn, share, connect, and grow.

What You Will Build
  • A thriving private community (Slack / Circle / platform of your choice)
  • Programs that turn users into loyal advocates
  • Relationships with agencies, ESPs, and industry experts
  • Events, webinars, office hours, and meetups
  • Educational initiatives and certifications
  • Feedback loops between customers and product
  • Ambassador and partner programs
  • A sense of belonging around the Warmy brand

You will own the community vision from zero to global scale.

What You Will Do
  • Define and execute Warmy’s community strategy
  • Recruit and onboard high-value members
  • Create engagement systems and rituals
  • Launch and run events (virtual and in-person)
  • Work closely with marketing, product, and sales teams
  • Identify industry influencers and partnerships
  • Turn community insights into growth opportunities
  • Measure engagement, retention, and advocacy metrics
  • Be the public face of the community when needed\
Who You Are
  • 4+ years building or managing communities (SaaS, tech, or professional communities preferred)
  • Naturally social and relationship-driven
  • Comfortable speaking publicly and hosting events
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution skills
  • High ownership mentality
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — you create opportunities
  • You enjoy helping people succeed
  • You move fast and learn fast

If you love spreadsheets more than people, this is not your role.

KPIs That Matter

We are a KPI-driven company. Success will be measured by:

  • Community growth and active members
  • Engagement and participation rates
  • Customer retention and advocacy
  • Partner relationships created
  • Pipeline influenced by community
  • Brand authority in the industry
Why Join Warmy
  • Fully remote international team
  • Fast-growing AI SaaS company in scaling stage
  • High autonomy and ownership
  • Direct impact on company growth
  • Work closely with founder and leadership
  • Opportunity to build a category-defining ecosystem
  • Competitive compensation + performance incentives
The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

You might be a fit if:

  • You believe communities can change industries
  • You love connecting people
  • You enjoy building things from scratch
  • You are proactive and bold
  • You want to create something globally recognized

If you want to manage a forum — this is not the job.

If you want to build the center of an industry — let’s talk.

Sólida experiência comprovada em atividades de desenvolvimento de software (Frontend e Backend):

  • Backend
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java 17+ e Spring Boot 3.3.x.
  • Experiência com Spring WebFlux (Programação Reativa).
  • Implementação de Spring Security com OAuth2 Client (especialmente integrações SSO como Gov.br).
  • Conhecimento em Spring Cloud, OpenFeign, JPA/Hibernate e MapStruct.
  • Manipulação de banco de dados PostgreSQL e controle de versionamento de schemas com Flyway.

  • Desenvolvimento em Angular (versão 14 ou superior).
  • Domínio de TypeScript (v5.8) e uso de RxJS para fluxos reativos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em HTML5 e SCSS (Sass).
  • Uso de bibliotecas como PrimeNG, FontAwesome e integração de APIs REST.
  • Qualidade e Infraestrutura
  • Testes: Escrita de testes unitários com JUnit 5, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma e uso de WireMock.
  • DevOps: Experiência com Docker, orquestração em Kubernetes (K8s) e pipelines GitLab CI/CD.
  • Ferramentas: Gestão de dependências com Maven, redução de boilerplate com Lombok e documentação com SpringDoc/Swagger.

  • Conhecimento em Kafka Connect ou Kafka Streams.

title: Analista Sr Infraestrutura AWS e Redes (PJ | Remoto)
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ

Local: 100% Remoto

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um Analista Sênior de Infraestrutura com forte atuação em Cloud (AWS) e ambientes On‑Premise , com conhecimentos sólidos em Segurança de Redes , Firewalls, Middleware e ambientes de missão crítica. Será responsável por suportar ambientes híbridos, aplicações em microsserviços e produtos Cloud‑native, além de atuar na sustentação, deploys, provisionamento e segurança da infraestrutura.

A atuação envolve contato com equipes de Segurança, DevOps e Integração, além de participação em projetos de desmobilização, melhorias de arquitetura e manutenção de ambientes complexos.

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes AWS e On‑Premise .
  • Realizar atividades relacionadas a segurança de redes , incluindo análise, configuração e troubleshooting de firewalls .
  • Suporte e manutenção em ambientes de infraestrutura em conjunto com as equipes internas.
  • Aplicação de patches de segurança , configurações de rede, provisionamento, acessos e governança de ambientes.
  • Suporte e acompanhamento de ambientes com microsserviços (sobretudo em AWS).
  • Realização de deploys, sustentação de ambientes e apoio à fábrica de integração (MuleSoft e Kafka).
  • Administração e suporte a servidores Linux e Windows (predominância Linux).
  • Colaboração com o time de Segurança para demandas de segurança aplicável (patches, controles, ajustes).
  • Interface com o time de DevOps para discussões técnicas.
  • Suporte de segundo nível, contando com apoio do CSC para atividades de N1.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Forte experiência em Infraestrutura AWS (EC2, VPC, Load Balancers, IAM, Security Groups, CloudWatch etc.).
  • Experiência com ambientes On‑Premise (redes, servidores, virtualização).
  • Domínio em Segurança de Redes , incluindo Firewall e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimentos em Linux (principal) e Windows Server .
  • Conhecimento de Storage , provisionamento, acessos, e governança.
  • Experiência com aplicação de patches de segurança
  • Desejáveis / Diferenciais
  • Experiência com MuleSoft .
  • Entendimento geral de práticas DevOps .
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de desmobilização/mobilização de sistemas , especialmente envolvendo ERPs.

title: Analista de FinOps Sênior - GCP | Azure | Cloudability
description:
A Ivy Group está com uma nova oportunidade para Analista de FinOps Sênior atuar em um de nossos clientes do segmento corporativo.

Buscamos um profissional com experiência prática em FinOps e gestão financeira em Cloud, capaz de atuar como ponto focal da disciplina dentro do cliente. Este papel será responsável por coordenar a operação de FinOps entre duas consultorias parceiras, sendo uma especializada em Cloudability Apptio e outra com atuação em DevOps nas plataformas Google Cloud e Azure.

Procuramos alguém com perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultado, que consiga transformar dados em direcionamentos claros, estruturar backlog de melhorias e apoiar a coordenação na tomada de decisão baseada em indicadores financeiros e técnicos.

Sobre a oportunidade

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica PJ ou Cooperativa
  • Modalidade: Remota
  • Atuação: Full time

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como responsável operacional pela agenda de FinOps dentro do cliente
  • Ser o elo entre a consultoria responsável pelo Cloudability e a consultoria com DevOps atuando em GCP e Azure
  • Traduzir recomendações geradas pelo Cloudability em planos de ação estruturados
  • Organizar e priorizar backlog de iniciativas de otimização de custos
  • Definir demandas como criação e evolução de dashboards, relatórios e visões executivas
  • Acompanhar indicadores de consumo, eficiência e oportunidades de savings
  • Apoiar a coordenação do cliente com análises e apresentações de resultados
  • Garantir que recomendações técnicas sejam convertidas em execução prática

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em FinOps ou Cloud Financial Management
  • Domínio dos princípios da FinOps Foundation
  • Experiência com Cloudability Apptio
  • Conhecimento sólido em Google Cloud Platform GCP e Microsoft Azure
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados financeiros e técnicos
  • Experiência atuando com múltiplos stakeholders
  • Boa comunicação para apresentação de resultados e recomendações

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com chargeback e showback
  • Vivência estruturando dashboards financeiros de Cloud
  • Experiência anterior atuando entre múltiplos fornecedores ou consultorias
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de otimização como rightsizing, reservations, savings plans e commitments

Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil de liderança prática e gosta de fazer projetos acontecerem de verdade, queremos conhecer você.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?

    • Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.

    We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.

    We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.

    What you’ll do..

    As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

    • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
    • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
    • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
    • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
    • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
    • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
    • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates

    This is not a passive customer success role.

    It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.

    You’ll likely do well here if you:

    • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
    • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
    • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
    • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
    • Take feedback well and apply it
    • Have strong written and spoken English skills
    • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results

    What you’ll get:

    • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
    • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
    • Fully remote working environment
    • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

description:

title: Gerente de negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga

Evoluir as práticas, ferramentas e habilidades de administração de vendas e gestão de contas para aprimorar o atendimento das expectativas dos nossos clientes e expandir em novos negócios

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar as áreas de negócios na prospecção, qualificação e fechamento de oportunidades de vendas, identificando necessidades, prazos e orçamento para a venda de produtos e/ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e utilizando o CRM na gestão das contas nomeadas e oportunidades em cada fase do processo de venda, visando atingir as metas estabelecidas;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para venda de produtos e serviços em soluções departamentais e/ou corporativas, negociando as condições das propostas para a efetivação da venda e analisando condições técnicas e comerciais de contratos de prestação de serviços com base na orientação da área de Contratos;
  • Estruturar proposta técnica com apoio do arquiteto, entendendo os requisitos do cliente, identificando e estruturando soluções de negócios que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e compondo preços de vendas de produtos/soluções e serviços;
  • Formular termos de referências e propostas comerciais, utilizando como referência modelos existentes e contando com apoio (Gestão, Executivo, Arquiteto, Gerente de Negócios ou Analista de Negócios);
  • Realizar apresentações executivas de produtos/soluções e serviços para clientes.
  • Criar estratégias de posicionamento dos produtos/soluções da Imagem nos clientes, mapeando perfis de cliente e identificando influenciadores, decisores, agentes externos e concorrentes;
  • Interagir com as todas as áreas promovendo o alinhamento de ideias e práticas em relação aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Desenvolver e manter uma rede comercial consistente, contemplando carteira de clientes e rede de contatos que contribua para a geração de negócios da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Conhecimento em processo de venda de produto e serviços;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas; Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado.

Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Microsoft Office;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimentos de Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Experiência em vendas de soluções para Governo;

Informações adicionais

  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.

title: Analista Atração e Seleção PL (Vaga Afirmativa PCD)
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção apaixonada por diversidade e inclusão, com experiência em conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, especialmente em ambientes com alto volume de vagas e perfis variados. Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para profissionais PCDs que desejam fazer a diferença promovendo um ambiente mais plural e representativo.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir processos seletivos de diferentes níveis e áreas (foco em posições operacionais)
  • Atuar com alto volume de vagas simultâneas, garantindo agilidade e qualidade na entrega;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de atração com foco em diversidade;
  • Realizar triagens, entrevistas por competências e dinâmicas de grupo;
  • Apoiar na construção de parcerias com consultorias e instituições voltadas à inclusão;
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva para todas as pessoas candidatas;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizados os sistemas de recrutamento (ATS);

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com recrutamento e seleção, especialmente em vagas de volume;
  • Conhecimento em entrevistas por competências e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental;
  • Vivência com ações afirmativas e programas de diversidade e inclusão;
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de ATS/Plataformas de divulgações;

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção apaixonada por diversidade e inclusão, com experiência em conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, especialmente em ambientes com alto volume de vagas e perfis variados. Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para profissionais PCDs que desejam fazer a diferença promovendo um ambiente mais plural e representativo.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir processos seletivos de diferentes níveis e áreas (foco em posições operacionais)
  • Atuar com alto volume de vagas simultâneas, garantindo agilidade e qualidade na entrega;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de atração com foco em diversidade;
  • Realizar triagens, entrevistas por competências e dinâmicas de grupo;
  • Apoiar na construção de parcerias com consultorias e instituições voltadas à inclusão;
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva para todas as pessoas candidatas;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizados os sistemas de recrutamento (ATS);

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com recrutamento e seleção, especialmente em vagas de volume;
  • Conhecimento em entrevistas por competências e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental;
  • Vivência com ações afirmativas e programas de diversidade e inclusão;
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de ATS/Plataformas de divulgações;

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde

title: Especialista em Energia  – Setor Elétrico e Transição Energética
description:
OBJETIVO:

Integrar a equipe técnica do Instituto E+ com atuação transversal em temas do setor elétrico, apoiando estudos, projetos, formulação de posições institucionais e interlocução técnica com stakeholders do setor.


PERFIL GERAL

Buscamos uma pessoa com autonomia, capacidade de execução, visão sistêmica do setor elétrico e flexibilidade para atuar em diferentes temas. Não é uma oportunidade puramente acadêmica nem exclusivamente regulatória — valorizamos perfil prático, resolutivo e colaborativo.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoiar e desenvolver estudos técnicos e estratégicos sobre o setor elétrico brasileiro
  • Contribuir para análises sobre mercado de energia, regulação e transição energética
  • Participar da elaboração de posicionamentos institucionais e notas técnicas
  • Apoiar projetos relacionados à modernização do setor, renováveis, GD, armazenamento, planejamento e governança
  • Interagir com stakeholders (governo, reguladores, empresas, academia e sociedade civil)
  • Contribuir para atividades do Instituto em fóruns e iniciativas nacionais e internacionais

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Energia, Economia da Energia ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia no setor elétrico brasileiro
  • Conhecimento desejável em:

-Mercado de energia (ACL, ACR, PLD)

- Regulação e funcionamento do setor (CCEE, ONS, ANEEL, EPE)

- Mecanismos como MRE, comercialização, contratos, formação de preços

  • Capacidade analítica e de síntese
  • Boa redação técnica

  • Capacidade de transitar entre análise técnica e visão estratégica

title: DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer / SRE Sênior para atuar na operação e evolução de uma plataforma baseada em microserviços, com foco em automação, confiabilidade e entrega contínua em ambiente multi-cloud (Azure + AWS).


Responsabilidades

  • Operar e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) com GitOps (Argo CD), garantindo padrões de deploy, rollback e controles por ambiente.
  • Manter e melhorar pipelines CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions) com pipelines-as-code em YAML.
  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e empacotamento/deploy com Helm (charts e padrões).
  • Evoluir observabilidade (métricas, logs, alertas e dashboards) e apoiar troubleshooting ponta a ponta.
  • Atuar em incidentes, análises pós-incidente (postmortems) e melhorias contínuas de confiabilidade.
  • Operar serviços de plataforma como Redis e Apache Solr com foco em disponibilidade, estabilidade, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gerenciar segredos e credenciais com Azure Key Vault e AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Operar registries de contêiner (ACR/ECR) e rotinas de imagens Docker (pull/push, credenciais e políticas).


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de produção com Azure e AWS.
  • Kubernetes (AKS e/ou EKS) e Docker.
  • GitOps com Argo CD.
  • CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (YAML).
  • Infraestrutura como código com Terraform e deploy com Helm.
  • Base sólida de Linux e fundamentos de rede (DNS, HTTP/TLS, balanceamento/ingress) para troubleshooting.


Diferenciais

  • Estratégias de deploy (blue/green, canary, rolling).
  • APM e tracing distribuído (ex.: Datadog/New Relic, OpenTelemetry).
  • Práticas FinOps (governança e otimização de custos em cloud).
  • Experiência adicional com service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) e/ou gateways (APIM, API Gateway, Kong).
  • Práticas DevSecOps: scanning de vulnerabilidades (Trivy, Snyk), secrets rotation, políticas de compliance e hardening de pipelines.


Modelo de contratação

  • Regime: PJ ou CLT - CONTRATAÇÃO URGÊNTE
  • Senioridade: Sênior
  • Formato: Remoto ou híbrido

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

No cargo de Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente, você será responsável por fornecer assistência eficiente aos clientes, garantindo a resolução de dúvidas e problemas relacionados aos produtos e serviços da empresa. Você deverá dominar as ferramentas e sistemas comercializados, acompanhar todas as atualizações e aplicar seus conhecimentos em informática para orientar os usuários em tarefas como a inserção de novos usuários, criação de categorias e navegação pelos menus do sistema.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar o atendimento de clientes dos serviços da empresa via telefone, e-mail, chat ou videoconferência;
  • Manter os clientes informados sobre mudanças no serviço, tendências e oportunidades;
  • Registrar demandas, pedidos de suporte e sugestões repassadas pelos usuários;
  • Auxiliar os usuários na resolução de problemas de baixa complexidade;
  • Efetuar a triagem de problemas, e garantir correto encaminhamento das demandas para demais responsáveis e áreas da empresa, quando necessário;
  • Auxiliar no teste de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e pilotos;
  • Registrar tickets de inconsistências e sugestões na ferramenta de gestão de projetos;
  • Incrementar o FAQ de atendimento ao cliente, à medida que novas perguntas e respostas surgem;
  • Gravação de tutoriais.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação em andamento ou concluída em Psicologia, Administração, Comunicação, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência com atendimento ao cliente, atendimento por ligações e videochamadas.
  • Conhecimento técnico intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Expressar-se de forma clara e sucinta;
  • Empatia, carisma e postura cordial;
  • Ser paciente e proativo.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.

Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare

The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.

What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned

What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English

Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)

Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.

Travel:

· 5-10%

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare

· Other duties assigned
